decisions.question: R-IJ: an orphan witness trace is retired when superseded (REFREEZE-WITNESS-Q option A)
decisions.recommendation: A post witness trace with no golden capture and no recapture.json entry is an orphan; it is deleted by literal path when a recipe-backed trace of the same slug witnesses a superset of its statement fingerprints (proved by the printed subset check), otherwise it gets a recipe and is retaken. First application: link_wsib cohort-entities, whose 39 statement fingerprints equal sources-full-forced-5's.
